title: Floord Putter

fields.label: Speed
fields.value: 44~ Studs/s on Grass - 54~ Studs/s on Road

body:
Description

The Floord Putter is the upgrade of the Rusty Putter.

Its speed on a road speed is 54 studs/s, while its Off-road speed is 44 studs/s.

The description says: This smol little guy has 50 horsepower and is not afraid to take steep turns to get where it needs!
